target: Deterministic, path-free personal Environment profiles with trusted read-only exchange, comparison, and review-first convergence plans.
primary_semantics: Environment Plane owns profile identity and comparison; Exchange Plane carries immutable evidence through environment-v1; Product Shell exposes preview-only controls.
invariants: Profile capture never reads outside explicitly supplied Rule files and Skill roots.
Profiles contain no credentials, environment values, hostnames, usernames, absolute paths, archives, conversations, indexes, models, caches, or executable state.
Imported profiles are immutable read-only peer evidence and cannot invoke an installer.
Rule convergence may name only one managed block and Skill convergence may link only an already verified immutable package.
Raw archives, summaries, indexes, and replicas are byte-identical before and after profile operations.
allowed_changes: Add a closed profile schema, deterministic bounded inventory, immutable generations, and atomic current pointer.
Add environment-v1 profile events and read-only per-peer profile replicas.
Add explicit comparison outcomes and bounded evidence-only convergence plans.
Add preview-first CLI and dashboard views plus release evidence.
prohibited_changes: Automatically install, update, enable, disable, remove, or downgrade any persistent capability.
Copy complete Rule files, project-scoped content, provider-owned packages, credentials, runtimes, models, or local paths.
Treat display names as stable identity or received profiles as installation authority.
Modify, normalize, compact, merge, or delete memory archives or derived memory artifacts.
before_after_checks: Hash unchanged fixtures twice and prove one generation and one export event.
Change a Skill, a managed Rule block, and an ignored cache independently.
Inject unreadable, linked, malformed, duplicate, oversized, non-UTF8, unknown-field, and tampered inputs.
Exercise trusted resumable exchange, replay, wrong target, untrusted peer, conflict, and corruption.
Rehearse existing managed-block and verified Skill installer preview, apply, and rollback contracts without profile authority.
